items.title: 68516_Gene Ramey oral history interview
items.q: Tabby Smith had -- all of them in those days

ctx.x: And Tabby Smith -- wasn't there something wrong with him?

Tabby Smith had -- all of them in those days, those trumpet players and saxophone players were always filing their mouthpieces. And it was a possibility of them getting brass that they shaved off into their lips.
